method: Separate supervised rim/surface heatmap CNNs for RGB and color-outline inputs. Gaussian heatmap cross entropy + 0.2 point smooth-L1 + 40*(level MSE + 0.25 worst-quartile MSE). Calibrated image rays reconstruct normalized liquid height. Native train-only crop alternatives; no validation gradients or reserved images. Known height/diameter/aspect channels additionally condition feature extraction; new-channel weights initialize to zero from the respective R14 model. Epoch zero is evaluated to retain a passing baseline. TF32 is permitted only during optimization; validation and inference use full-precision convolutions. Interrupted R15 state is retained; the same seed/initialization are used.
